summary: Phase 2 Admin Home / KPIs Dashboard — full end-to-end validation. Passwordless OTP login works via public preview URL; all 6 dashboard endpoints return correct data with prosper_session cookie; 401 without auth and 403 for client_admin role are both enforced on every endpoint. Frontend /admin renders the full dashboard: data-testid='admin-home' present, all 6 KPI tiles (AUM $23,175,000.00 · NAV 1.021415 · Revenue MTD $1,552.50 · Volume 30D $4,425,000.00 · Active Clients 2 · Ops Queue 0), three SVG charts (nav-chart, volume-chart, revenue-chart), top-clients table with both Finpact ($11.9M) and Alemany Capital ($11.3M), Ops Queue panel with 5 rows including 'KYB PENDING · 1 · Finpact PENDING', range switcher (7d/30d/90d) toggles the volume KPI label, and the Refresh button re-fires all 6 SWR network requests. 23/23 pytest cases pass.

minor.issue: Returns N+1 items (e.g. 91 items for ?days=90, 31 for ?days=30, 8 for ?days=7) because the fill loop uses `while day <= now` without capping like /nav-history does (which slices `series[-days:]`). Chart still renders correctly because the frontend just maps items. Suggest adding `out = out[-days:]` before returning, or use `<` instead of `<=`.

issues: Several /_next preloaded woff2 fonts (Plex Mono / Chivo) emit 'preloaded but not used' console warnings — purely cosmetic, no functional impact. Consider trimming the font preload list or wiring `display: swap` so warnings disappear.

action_items: (Minor) Cap /admin/dashboard/volume output to `days` items to match /nav-history's behaviour (off-by-one — currently returns N+1).
critical_code_review_comments: routes_dashboard.py · /nav-history: the aggregation pipeline is computed but `cum_principal` is then discarded — the NAV series is purely synthetic (1.0 * (1 + 0.085/365)^day). Either drop the unused pipeline (saves a Mongo round-trip) or actually feed `cum_principal` into the NAV math. As-is this is dead code masquerading as 'real-time'.

routes_dashboard.py · /revenue uses `timedelta(days=31 * (months-1))` to roll back N months — this is approximate and drifts (e.g. 12 months ago becomes ~341 days, not 365). Use `dateutil.relativedelta` or compute first-of-month math explicitly.

routes_dashboard.py · `aum_delta_24h` and `nav_delta_24h` are computed against `created_at <= yday` which on a freshly seeded DB returns identical values (delta = 0.00%) — the UI then shows '0.00% 24h' on AUM and NAV. Consider tying delta to a real prior-day snapshot (e.g. a daily NAV snapshot collection) so the KPIs aren't always flat in fresh environments.

routes_dashboard.py · `/ops-queue` returns `webhook_failing` and `reconciliation` as hardcoded zero placeholders — fine for now but please mark them with a `# TODO Phase 2.x` comment so they don't silently stay at 0 once webhooks/recon modules ship.
routes_dashboard.py is 303 lines and tightly couples 6 endpoints + aggregation pipelines — consider splitting per-endpoint files under /backend/routes/dashboard/ once the placeholders fill in.

rca of the issue: No bugs reproduced. The only finding is the /volume endpoint off-by-one (returns days+1 items) which is cosmetic — the frontend chart handles it transparently. RCA: /volume uses `while day <= now` without slicing, while /nav-history uses the same loop but then does `series[-days:]`. Mitigation: add the same slice (or change <= to <) so both endpoints behave consistently.
